courses.title: System Design Foundations
courses.description: Core system design concepts covering APIs, data stores, partitioning, consistency, caching, messaging, transactions, and scale-oriented data structures.

videos.title: How to Learn System Design with Jordan Has No Life
videos.revised_title_from_ai: How to Learn System Design with Jordan Has No Life
videos.description: Stefan interviews Jordan, the creator of the YouTube channel 'Jordan Has No Life.' They discuss Jordan's journey into system design, his learning process, and the evolution of his content creation. Jordan shares insights on the importance of understanding core concepts, the value of personal projects, and the trends in system design. They also touch on the impact of AI on engineering and the significance of practical decision-making in system design.

videos.title: Separate DB per service? Explained in 60 seconds. #systemdesign #softwaredesign #interviewquestions
videos.revised_title_from_ai: Separate DB per service? Explained in 60 seconds. #systemdesign #softwaredesign #interviewquestions
videos.description: Do you really need a separate database for that? Maybe. If you're a junior engineer and you don't have a lot of experience, it's probably not a bad idea to lean on this rule. But interviewers may be looking for different things from you and it's just as possible to create an untenable design that feels overengineered. Explain your choices and justify them in terms of the requirements of the system and what your interviewer is looking for. You don't get any special credit for banging on the rulebook!

videos.revised_title_from_ai: ACID Databases
videos.description: ACID are properties of databases that make application development easier and less prone to errors. They're provided by most relational databases and a growing number of NoSQL databases. ACID is difficult to guarantee at scale, so it's often the first requirement relaxed as your service grows.

videos.title: Helping guide the interviewer in Behavioral interviews
videos.revised_title_from_ai: Helping guide the interviewer in Behavioral interviews
videos.description: Guiding the interviewer toward the most interesting aspects of your experience is one of the key challenges for candidates. If you don't do this well, interviewers will wander through questions never uncovering the most important parts of your experience!

videos.title: How to become good at behavioral interviews
videos.revised_title_from_ai: How to become good at behavioral interviews
videos.description: A lot of the core skills necessary to progress as an engineer make a showing in your behavioral interview: how do you deliver results under ambiguity, how do you build trust with your leadership, how can you collaborate well with teammates. Being able to introspect on what worked and what didn't is part of the "inner loop" of career optimization and, by doing it well, you'll be well-positioned to crush your behavioral interviews.

videos.title: Answering When You Don't Have Experience
videos.revised_title_from_ai: Answering When You Don't Have Experience

He discusses the balance between strategy and tactics, identifies common red flags, and offers advice for new managers and those transitioning from long-term roles. The conversation also highlights the necessity of maintaining technical skills and preparing for coding interviews, while addressing the importance of storytelling in conveying managerial experiences.

videos.title: Red Flags in People Manager Interviews #engineeringleadership #interviews
